messages:
Alex: Heads-up — PR #2876 is almost ready but I'm holding on a few small style nits (naming + gofmt). Can someone do a quick pass? Trying to merge in today's window.

Jin: I fixed most rename nits across 3 files, left one proto/json-tag question. Pushing a tiny follow-up in a sec.

Sam: @Alex I can give a quick approve after CI goes green. Noted — one test is flakey on my machine but should be fine.

CI-bot: buildkite/pr-2876: FAILED — gofmt differences detected in runtime/kvcache/kv_store.go

Jin: hmm I ran `gofmt -w` locally, maybe I missed that file. Pushing a fix now. Also changed the exported type name -> internal variant. Quick diff: 
```diff
- type KVCache struct {
+ type kvCache struct {
```

Maria: @Jin thanks — small design nit: we should keep the exported constructor `NewKVCache` but internal type can be `kvCache`. That preserves API while fixing casing. Also, can you keep the json tag `json:"kv_cache"` on the struct?

Jin: yep makes sense. Will keep `NewKVCache` public and rename the type to `kvCache`, keep the tag. Pushing and will squash into the original commit.

Sam: cool — I'll re-run CI once the push lands. If green, I'll approve in the next ~30m. :clock3:

Alex: Thanks everyone. @Maria if you want to skim the follow-up quickly that'd be great. :thumbsup:
